title: George H.W. Bush: Cautious
credits: Kelly Jean Kelly wrote this story for Learning English. George Grow was the editor.

sentences.en: VOA Learning English presents America’s Presidents.
sentences.zh: 美国之音英语学习节目为您带来《美国总统》系列。

sentences.en: Today we are talking about George Herbert Walker Bush.
sentences.zh: 今天我们聊聊小乔治·赫伯特·沃克·布什。

sentences.en: Before he became president in 1989, Bush had a lot of experience in government.
sentences.zh: 在1989年出任总统之前，布什拥有丰富的政府工作经验。

sentences.en: He spent four years in the United States House of Representatives, worked as the U.S. ambassador to the United Nations, and led the Central Intelligence Agency, or CIA.
sentences.zh: 他曾在众议院任职四年，担任美国驻联合国大使，并领导中央情报局，即中情局。

sentences.en: Then, for eight years, he was vice president under Ronald Reagan.
sentences.zh: 此后，他又在罗纳德·里根总统任内担任了八年副总统。

sentences.en: Interestingly, in U.S. history, a person serving as vice president rarely becomes president after the sitting president leaves office at the end of his term.
sentences.zh: 有趣的是，在美国历史上，一位在任副总统很少能在现任总统任期届满离任后接任总统。

sentences.en: Before George H.W.
sentences.zh: 在小乔治·H·W·

sentences.en: Bush, the last time such an event happened was in 1836.
sentences.zh: 布什之前，此类情况最后一次出现是在1836年。

sentences.en: At that time, Martin Van Buren took office after the two-term presidency of Andrew Jackson.
sentences.zh: 当时，马丁·范布伦在安德鲁·杰克逊连任两届总统之后就职。

sentences.en: Yet neither Bush nor Van Buren was able to successfully deal with some of the problems facing the country during their years in office, or to persuade voters to elect them for a second term.
sentences.zh: 然而，布什和范布伦都未能成功应对他们在任期内所面临的一些国家难题，也未能说服选民再次选举他们连任。

sentences.en: While many people respect Bush for his foreign policy successes, his years in office are also remembered as a time of economic problems and social unrest.
sentences.zh: 尽管许多人敬重布什在外交政策上的成就，但他在任的八年同样被铭记为一个经济困难与社会动荡的时期。

sentences.en: George Bush was born into a wealthy family in Massachusetts, and raised in a Connecticut town near New York City.
sentences.zh: 乔治·布什出生于马萨诸塞州的一个富裕家庭，在纽约市附近的一个康涅狄格州小镇长大。

sentences.en: He had three brothers and a sister.
sentences.zh: 他有三位兄弟和一位姐妹。

sentences.en: Their father was a business leader who became a U.S. senator.
sentences.zh: 他们的父亲是一位商界领袖，后来成为美国参议员。

sentences.en: Their mother was active doing public service work.
sentences.zh: 他们的母亲积极参与公共服务工作。

sentences.en: The family employed servants, but Mrs. Bush did not want her children’s privileged position to make them think they were special.
sentences.zh: 这家人雇用了仆人，但布什夫人不希望孩子们享有特权的地位让他们自认为与众不同。

sentences.en: Instead, she taught them to work hard and help others.
sentences.zh: 相反，她教导他们要努力工作、帮助他人。

sentences.en: When he was a young man, George Bush moved away from home to attend a private high school in Massachusetts.
sentences.zh: 年轻时，乔治·布什离开家乡，前往马萨诸塞州的一所私立高中就读。

sentences.en: There, he played baseball and soccer, and was elected student body president.
sentences.zh: 在那里，他打了棒球和足球，并当选为学生会主席。

sentences.en: On his 18th birthday, Bush joined the U.S. Navy.
sentences.zh: 在他18岁生日那天，布什加入了美国海军。

sentences.en: For three years, he fought in World War II.
sentences.zh: 他在第二次世界大战中作战三年。

sentences.en: At the time, he was the youngest pilot in the Navy, and earned a medal for bravery.In early 1945, he married a young woman he had met at a dance.
sentences.zh: 当时，他是海军中最年轻的飞行员，并因勇敢而获得一枚奖章。1945年初，他娶了一位在舞会上认识的女子。

sentences.en: Her name was Barbara Pierce.
sentences.zh: 她的名字是芭芭拉·皮尔斯。

sentences.en: After the war, she and George moved to Connecticut, where he studied economics at Yale University and played on the school’s baseball team.
sentences.zh: 战后，她和乔治搬到康涅狄格州，他在那里进入耶鲁大学学习经济学，并参加了学校的棒球队。

sentences.en: In time, they moved to the southern state of Texas.
sentences.zh: 后来，他们搬到了南部的得克萨斯州。

sentences.en: George Bush worked in the oil industry, and became president of a company that sold oil drilling equipment.
sentences.zh: 乔治·布什在石油行业工作，并成为一家销售石油钻探设备公司的总裁。

sentences.en: George and Barbara Bush mostly raised their four sons and one daughter in the Houston, Texas area.
sentences.zh: 乔治和芭芭拉·布什主要在得克萨斯州休斯顿地区抚养他们的四个儿子和一个女儿。

sentences.en: Another daughter died of cancer when she was a child.
sentences.zh: 另一个女儿在童年时因癌症去世。

sentences.en: In time, George Bush decided to follow his father’s example and enter politics.
sentences.zh: 后来，乔治·布什决定效仿父亲的榜样，从政。

sentences.en: He became a Republican Party official.
sentences.zh: 他成为共和党的官员。

sentences.en: Then he was elected to the U.S. Congress, representing part of Houston.
sentences.zh: 随后，他当选为美国国会议员，代表休斯顿的一部分地区。

sentences.en: Despite having a home in Texas, opponents and the public connected Bush with the East Coast and the upper class.
sentences.zh: 尽管在得克萨斯州拥有住所，反对者和公众却将布什与东海岸及上流社会联系在一起。

sentences.en: That image created some problems for Bush in the presidential election of 1980.
sentences.zh: 这一形象在1980年的总统选举中给布什带来了一些麻烦。

sentences.en: By then, he had held other high offices in the federal government, and had been successful as the head of the CIA.
sentences.zh: 到那时，他已在联邦政府中担任过其他高级职务，并作为中央情报局局长取得了成功。

sentences.en: But voters liked another Republican candidate, former California governor Ronald Reagan.
sentences.zh: 但选民们更喜欢另一位共和党候选人、前加利福尼亚州州长罗纳德·里根。

sentences.en: Many Americans remembered Reagan from his days in movies and on television.
sentences.zh: 许多美国人从里根在电影和电视上的岁月里就认识他。

sentences.en: When Reagan was nominated as the party’s candidate for president, he asked Bush to be vice president.
sentences.zh: 当里根被提名为该党总统候选人时，他请布什担任副总统。

sentences.en: For eight years, Bush held the office, and worked closely with Reagan on foreign policy and other issues.
sentences.zh: 八年间，布什担任这一职务，并在外交政策及其他问题上与里根密切合作。

sentences.en: In 1988, Bush finally won the presidency in his own right.
sentences.zh: 1988年，布什最终凭借自身实力赢得了总统之位。

sentences.en: On entering the White House, the new president promised to continue many of Reagan’s policies of limited government.
sentences.zh: 进入白宫时，这位新总统承诺将继续里根许多限制政府的政策。

sentences.en: While he was a candidate, Bush often said that, if elected, he would not raise taxes.
sentences.zh: 在担任候选人期间，布什经常说，如果当选，他不会增税。

sentences.en: Bush also said that he wanted the United States to be “a kinder and gentler” nation.
sentences.zh: 布什还说，他希望美国成为一个“更仁慈、更温和”的国家。

sentences.en: He wanted especially to support community organizations in their efforts to reduce crime, homelessness, and drug abuse.
sentences.zh: 他尤其希望支持社区组织在减少犯罪、无家可归和药物滥用方面所作的努力。

sentences.en: He also signed legislation to help people with disabilities, and to protect the environment.
sentences.zh: 他还签署了帮助残障人士和保护环境的立法。

sentences.en: But Bush faced a number problems.
sentences.zh: 然而，布什面临着一系列问题。

sentences.en: One was a large budget deficit, created in part by increased military spending during the Reagan years.
sentences.zh: 其中一个就是庞大的财政赤字，这部分是由于里根执政期间军费开支增加所造成的。

sentences.en: Another were disputes in Congress with the Democratic Party.
sentences.zh: 另一个是在国会与民主党人发生的争端。

sentences.en: And another was a banking crisis.
sentences.zh: 还有一个就是银行危机。

sentences.en: After years of problems in the savings and loan industry, more than 1,000 small financial institutions failed.
sentences.zh: 在储蓄和贷款业经历了多年的问题之后，有一千多家小型金融机构倒闭。

sentences.en: In time, Congress agreed to spend billions of dollars to help the industry recover.
sentences.zh: 经过一段时间，国会同意花费数百亿美元来帮助该行业恢复。

sentences.en: And President Bush had to break his promise not to raise taxes.
sentences.zh: 而布什不得不违背他不增税的承诺。

sentences.en: He pointed out that he needed to balance the budget; however, many Americans and some members of his own party felt betrayed.
sentences.zh: 他指出，他需要平衡预算；然而，许多美国人以及他所在党的一些成员感到被背叛了。

sentences.en: The economic troubles helped create a mood of unrest in the country.
sentences.zh: 经济困难帮助在这个国家营造了一种动荡不安的气氛。

sentences.en: The feeling was strengthened by events around the world.
sentences.zh: 这种情绪受到世界各地事件的强化。

sentences.en: Soon after Bush took office, the Chinese government launched a campaign to stop protests in Beijing’s Tiananmen Square.
sentences.zh: 布什上任不久，中国政府就发起了一场制止北京天安门广场抗议活动的运动。

sentences.en: A few months later, the Berlin Wall came down.
sentences.zh: 几个月后，柏林墙倒塌了。

sentences.en: The wall separated East and West Germany.
sentences.zh: 这堵墙把东德和西德分隔开来。

sentences.en: Many considered its collapse to be the end of the Soviet Union’s control of Eastern Europe.
sentences.zh: 许多人认为它的倒塌标志着苏联对东欧控制的结束。

sentences.en: At the same time, the leader of Panama, Manuel Noriega, was threatening Americans.
sentences.zh: 与此同时，巴拿马领袖曼努埃尔·诺列加正在威胁美国人。

sentences.en: He was also accused of supporting drug traffickers and the drug trade in the United States.
sentences.zh: 他还被指控支持美国的毒品走私者和毒品贸易。

sentences.en: Bush answered all the events in a calm, cautious way.
sentences.zh: 布什以冷静、谨慎的方式应对了所有事件。

sentences.en: He tried to keep good relations with China and the Soviet Union.
sentences.zh: 他努力与中国和苏联保持良好的关系。

sentences.en: In time, he ordered military action in Panama, and U.S. troops ousted Noriega.
sentences.zh: 后来，他下令在巴拿马采取军事行动，美军推翻了诺列加。

sentences.en: Supporters praised Bush’s cool head and way of doing things.
sentences.zh: 支持者赞扬布什沉着冷静以及他的行事方式。

sentences.en: But critics questioned Bush’s decisions.
sentences.zh: 但批评者质疑布什的决策。

sentences.en: Some said he went too far.
sentences.zh: 有人说他做得太过分了。

sentences.en: Others said he did not go far enough.
sentences.zh: 也有人说他没有做得足够。

sentences.en: The same criticisms and support were repeated during the Gulf War against Iraq.
sentences.zh: 在针对伊拉克的海湾战争期间，同样的批评和支持被反复提出。

sentences.en: In brief, Iraqi leader Saddam Hussein ordered his forces to invade and occupy Kuwait.
sentences.zh: 简而言之，伊拉克领导人萨达姆·侯赛因下令他的部队入侵并占领科威特。

sentences.en: Bush and other world leaders created an international coalition to seek a diplomatic solution.
sentences.zh: 布什和其他世界领导人组建了一个国际联盟，以寻求外交解决方案。

sentences.en: When diplomacy failed, U.S. troops led international air strikes against Iraq.
sentences.zh: 当外交失败后，美军领导了对伊拉克的国际空袭。

sentences.en: Coalition forces also attacked on the ground.
sentences.zh: 联盟部队也在地面发动了攻击。

sentences.en: In a few weeks, the Iraqi leadership agreed to a ceasefire.
sentences.zh: 在几周内，伊拉克领导层同意停火。

sentences.en: Some criticized Bush for letting Saddam Hussein stay in power.
sentences.zh: 有人批评布什让萨达姆·侯赛因继续掌权。

sentences.en: But the American public largely approved of Bush’s actions.
sentences.zh: 但美国公众总体上认可布什的行动。

sentences.en: He won praise for helping create an international coalition to answer the Iraqi occupation.
sentences.zh: 他因帮助组建应对伊拉克占领的国际联盟而获得赞誉。

sentences.en: The effort showed what some called a “New World Order.”
sentences.zh: 这一努力展现了一些人所称的“新世界秩序”。

sentences.en: The U.S. and Soviet Union had even worked successfully together.
sentences.zh: 美国和苏联甚至成功地携手合作。

sentences.en: Yet, soon after the end of the Gulf War, Bush failed in his efforts at re-election.
sentences.zh: 然而，在海湾战争结束后不久，布什在连任努力中失败了。

sentences.en: The U.S. economy had entered a recession.
sentences.zh: 美国经济已进入衰退期。

sentences.en: And Bush was not able to connect effectively with voters, even though those who knew him personally said Bush was a kind, gentle person.
sentences.zh: 布什无法有效地与选民建立联系,尽管那些 personally 认识他的人都说布什是个善良、温和的人。

sentences.en: One of his last acts as president was to write a note for the candidate who had beat him, wishing him well.
sentences.zh: 他作为总统的最后举措之一,是为击败自己的候选人写了一张便条,祝他一切顺利。

sentences.en: George H.W.
sentences.zh: 乔治·H·W·

sentences.en: Bush retired to his home in Texas with his wife, Barbara.
sentences.zh: 布什与妻子芭芭拉退隐到他在德克萨斯州的家中。

sentences.en: They also have a house in Maine.
sentences.zh: 他们在缅因州也有一栋房子。

sentences.en: Bush often urged Americans to help others in their community.
sentences.zh: 布什经常敦促美国人帮助社区中的他人。

sentences.en: He put his words into action by volunteering with his church and supporting a local hospital.
sentences.zh: 他通过参加教堂的志愿活动和支持当地医院,将言语付诸行动。

sentences.en: On his 90th birthday, Bush did something unusual to test his image as a cautious person.
sentences.zh: 在他90岁生日那天,布什做了一件不寻常的事,以测试他作为谨慎之人的形象。

sentences.en: He celebrated by going sky diving.
sentences.zh: 他以跳伞来庆祝。

sentences.en: For many, Bush is remembered for his connection to other presidents.
sentences.zh: 对许多人来说,人们因他与其它总统的联系而记住布什。

sentences.en: He is often linked to the Reagan years.
sentences.zh: 他经常里根时代联系在一起。

sentences.en: Compared to Reagan, Bush is usually considered a less conservative leader, as well as a less charismatic one.
sentences.zh: 与里根相比,布什通常被认为是一个不那么保守的领导人,也是一个更具魅力的领导人。

sentences.en: By the 21st century, historians began comparing the former president Bush with another president: his son, George Walker Bush, who took office eight years after his father left it.
sentences.zh: 到了21世纪,历史学家开始将前总统布什与另一位总统进行比较:他的儿子乔治·沃克·布什,他在父亲离任八年后就职。

sentences.en: I’m Kelly Jean Kelly.
sentences.zh: 我是凯莉·简·凯利。

glossary.def: having special rights or advantages that most people do not have
a tool used for making holes in hard substances
having or showing a kind and quiet nature : not harsh or violent
careful about avoiding danger or risk

glossary.zh: 有魅力的；有领袖魅力的
